answer: Voting influence draws on one tenure stream: pearl groups keys into operators by deployment-graph attestation, and each operator earns one nectar tenure unit per attested service epoch however many heads run; spiral allocates tenure \(t_i\) among \(k\) heads and gives head \(i\) weight \(t_i^2/k^4\). Bringing every head to weight 1 takes \(k^3\) units: one head costs 1 epoch, ten cost 1,000 serial epochs, and the tenth adds 271. Wallet rotation cannot change the graph; another operator starts at 1.
